messages:
alex: Quick check-in — ran activation-aware AWQ + SmoothQuant mix on grok-13b-64k (see cfg). small eval on 1k prompts shows some accuracy drift but big perf wins. posting numbers below

maria: thanks — can you paste the exact quant config and the eval delta?

alex: cfg: `awq+sq hybrid`, bits=8 (weights AWQ, activations SmoothQuant-ish), act_scale=auto, kv_cache 64k, calib_steps=2048, perlayer-clip=none

alex: smoke eval results (1k prompts, heldout dev set)
- baseline fp16: ppl=11.3, rougeL=42.1, pass@1=78.4
- quant hybrid: ppl=12.0 (+0.7), rougeL=41.4 (-0.7), pass@1=76.8 (-1.6)
- latency p50: fp16=180ms -> quant=95ms
- latency p99: fp16=420ms -> quant=240ms
- mem GPU: fp16=23GB -> quant=12.5GB

jordan: that -1.6 pass@1 is noticeable but not catastrophic. did you look at failure modes? long-context answers or truncation?

alex: mostly hallucination drift on multi-hop traces >32k. short Q/A fine. KV cache hits look normal; activation tails look higher in later layers (log attached).

maria: can we try act clipping + small smoothquant alpha tweak? also run AWQ calibration with 8k calibration samples instead of 2k. previous experiments showed act-aware clip helps tail stability.

anita: for rollout I'd recommend: canary to dedicated-64k pool (2 nodes), route 1% traffic, track pass@1 and rougeL and p99, have automatic fallback -> fp16 if pass@1 drops >2 points. Also add eval set with long-horizon prompts (50-64k).

alex: agreed. I'll run a follow-up with: act_clip=0.98, smooth_alpha=0.6, calib=8192. expecting smaller delta.

jordan: also try batch_size=1 vs 4 for latency/quant noise. AWQ seems sensitive to micro-batches for KV cache alignment.

ci-bot: canary deploy request created: canary-id=canary-2412345678-01, attach metrics stream -> prometheus/eng-ml/grok-13b-64k/canary-2412345678

maria: when you have the new run, attach the per-layer activation histograms + a short diff of logits on a few reference prompts. helps triage whether it's activation shift vs weight quantization.

alex: will do. target timeline: run calib+actclip overnight, post results AM. if pass@1 delta <=1.0 I'll schedule canary tomorrow. otherwise iterate.

anita: tagging eng-infra for capacity check — we'll need spare dedicated-64k nodes for canary. @eng-infra please confirm resources. :eyes:

alex: thanks — uploading seeds + eval script to the thread gist: https://internal.gists/2412345678 (private)

jordan: small note — add a shadow route option to mirror traffic for a day to gather real-world long-horizon logs before full rollout. low risk and good telemetry.

ci-bot: background job queued: quant-recalibrate-2412345678 (expected 3-4h with 4x A100).

alex: update 6h later — actclip/smooth_alpha run finished. quick numbers on the same 1k set:
- quant hybrid (actclip=0.98, alpha=0.6, calib=8192): ppl=11.6 (+0.3 vs fp16), rougeL=41.9 (-0.2), pass@1=77.6 (-0.8)
- latency p99: 230ms
- mem GPU: 13.0GB
Observations: long-horizon hallucination reduced vs prior run, tail activations still slightly higher but stable.

maria: that's promising. can we get the confusion examples for the regressed cases and run a small rerank eval?

alex: posted 10 worst diffs and rerank script to gist. also enabling canary per anita's plan now.

ci-bot: canary started (canary-2412345678-01) routing 1% to dedicated pool. dashboards: https://internal.metrics/canary-2412345678

anita: will monitor metrics for the next 6h. if anything looks bad we roll back and debug. thanks team. :thumbsup:
